name: acceptance-e2e
description: Turn a feature's requirements + the running app into an acceptance-criteria-traceable e2e suite in the project's own e2e harness — then go proactive: seven driven-and-asserted sweeps beyond the ACs (state-matrix forcing via interception, fault injection incl. offline/timeout/double-submit, interaction-integrity + reactivity, keyboard + axe a11y floor, data-shape stress over API-seeded edge fixtures, security surface incl. forged-action/IDOR/channel-authz, multi-user two-context realtime), a rendered-quality handoff that invokes the /design-review skill (deterministic WCAG/layout gates + judged craft/state/flow passes) and the mockup-fidelity layer where a design-of-record exists, surgical fixes for tractable bugs, and guard promotion — every sweep becomes a permanent CI/pre-push gate invoked by a named script, with new surfaces inheriting by enumeration. Coverage axes are enumerated and the sample declared up front; committed specs carry their run record. Lanes for native apps (Maestro deep-link-first, XCUITest, performAccessibilityAudit, and an Accessibility-tree runner for macOS apps XCUITest cannot reach - assert AXPress not just identifiers, fixture-mode determinism that also avoids stealing foreground focus, and the measured traps that make an AX harness blame the app), MCP servers (acceptance = a real MCP client driving the built server), and marketing sites (route x viewport loads, link/heading/meta audits, claim-grounding invariants). v1.4.0 phases 0-9, from the portfolio QA plan + the WEB-4905 audit. v1.6.0 moves the default runner off @playwright/test to node:test driving Obscura over CDP, wires the a11y floor by injecting axe-core (color-contrast lands in incomplete, never violations, under that engine), and states plainly what the conversion costs: no fixtures, no auto-retry, no parallel workers, no HTML reporter, no trace viewer.
